subject: Data retention & deletion SLAs — follow up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@amayahealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-18T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Data retention & deletion SLAs — follow up

Alex — great to meet today, thanks for the time. Quick post-call recap and next steps so we have alignment from the start:

Summary of ask:
- Amaya needs clarity on Redwood's data retention and deletion SLAs (including primary data, logs, and backups) to align with your internal compliance team and upcoming procurement.
- Confirm SOC 2 status, GDPR/HIPAA support, and initiate a vendor security questionnaire.

What we covered on the call:
- Typical retention windows we offer (primary customer data, logs, and backups) and the ability to configure per-account policies on Dedicated/Private deployments.
- Options for BAA and HIPAA support (Private deployment + BAA discussion).
- Redwood's SOC 2 status and where to find the report.

Immediate next steps (owner in parentheses):
1) I attached a short SOC 2 summary and our standard vendor security questionnaire template for your team to review (Marissa).
2) Please send the questionnaire back with any redlines or additional questions — Alex/Amaya legal/security.
3) I'll loop in our security/product SMEs to answer the detailed retention/backups questions and provide exact SLA language for contract inclusion (Neha / Rishi).
4) Schedule a 30-min follow-up with Amaya security once questionnaire is populated — propose next Wed 10/27 or Thu 10/28.

Quick answers to immediate questions you raised:
- Deletion SLA: Redwood supports account-level deletion requests; standard target is 30 days for primary customer data once a deletion job is initiated.
- Backups: Backups are retained separately (see attached notes) — we can provide a 90-day default with options for shorter/longer based on contract.
- Logs: We retain request logs for 90 days by default; we can discuss longer retention for audit purposes.

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary-2026.pdf, vendor-security-questionnaire-Amaya.xlsx

Thanks — looping in Neha and Rishi to help with the technical + contract wording.

—
Marissa Cole

From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@amayahealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-19T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Data retention & deletion SLAs — follow up

Marissa — thanks for the recap and the attachments. A few clarifying items from our compliance team before we populate the questionnaire:

1) Deletion SLA: when you say 30 days for primary data, does that include all copies (replicas) and any user-accessible snapshots? We need deletion guaranteed across replicas and must not leave orphaned PII in any persistent storage.

2) Backups: are backups included in the same deletion flow or is there a separate process? If backups are retained for 90 days, can we request immediate purge on a per-account basis (e.g., for high-risk data)?

3) Logs & forensics: our audit team asks whether request/operation logs are immutable and how long they can be exported for long-term retention. Is log export supported?

4) HIPAA: is a BAA available for hosted customers or only for Private/Dedicated? Our legal prefers hosted if possible.

If you can answer these items we can fill the questionnaire and loop in our security folks. Also, can you attach the full SOC 2 report (we escrow these) or point me to a secure download?

Thanks — Alex
Alex Chen
Security Program Manager, Amaya Health
alex.chen@amayahealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@amayahealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-20T11:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Data retention & deletion SLAs — follow up

Alex — thanks for the questions. Looping in Neha (Security) and Rishi (Product) to provide definitive answers and the SOC 2 report. Preliminary answers below to keep momentum: 

1) Deletion SLA (primary + replicas): Our standard deletion workflow targets complete removal of customer data from the live system and all synchronous replicas within 30 days. For asynchronous snapshots and long-term object storage (backups), we treat deletion as follows: primary deletion is initiated immediately; backups are scheduled for purge according to the backup retention policy (default 90 days) unless an expedited purge is contractually agreed. We will provide contract language that guarantees removal from all persistent copies within X days for your tier (we can propose 30 days for primary + 90 days for backups, with expedited purge options).

2) Backups & expedited purge: Backups are separate and retained per backup policy. We can support expedited purge requests on a case-by-case basis via contractual terms (service-level deletion on backups). Will outline options and any technical constraints.

3) Logs & export: Logs are retained 90 days by default. We support exporting logs (S3 export or secure transfer) for long-term archival before retention expiration. Logs used for forensics are immutable within the logging system for their retention window; we can provide an export process for longer-term retention.

4) HIPAA / BAA: Redwood supports HIPAA via a BAA. For hosted customers we provide a BAA contingent on deployment/config choices and specific controls; some customers prefer Private/Dedicated for additional network/data isolation. Neha will add details.

Neha / Rishi — can you please: (a) attach the SOC 2 Type II report or a secure link, (b) confirm exact wording we should use in contract for deletion SLAs (primary, backups, logs), and (c) confirm options/constraints for expedited backup purges?

I'll hold off on scheduling the follow-up until we've got the refreshed questionnaire and the SOC2 report.

—
Marissa

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@amayahealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-23T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Data retention & deletion SLAs — follow up

Alex / Marissa — thanks for the clear list. I pulled in the security and product-side details below and attached the formal SOC 2 Type II report and a completed vendor questionnaire template for Amaya to review. High-level answers and contract wording suggestions follow.

SOC 2 status:
- Redwood completed its most recent SOC 2 Type II assessment in Q1 2026. The report (SOC2-TypeII-Report-2026.pdf) is attached; we can provide an NDA/secure download link if required by procurement.

Recommended contract language (short):
- "Redwood shall, upon request, delete customer account data stored in the live service and all synchronous replicas within thirty (30) days following initiation of a deletion request. Backups and asynchronous snapshots shall be purged within ninety (90) days of a deletion request unless the parties execute an expedited purge addendum specifying a shorter timeframe and associated fees, if any."

Notes / clarifications:
- Replicas: synchronous replicas are covered by the 30-day SLA. Asynchronous replication (e.g., cross-region backup snapshots) follows the backup retention window.
- Backups: by default retained 90 days. Expedited purges are supported for accounts with contractual terms; technically we can prioritize a backup purge job but it requires coordination and may have operational windows to avoid data corruption during snapshot lifecycle.
- Logs: request/operation logs are retained for 90 days by default and are immutable within that window. We support export (S3 or secure transfer). For customers needing multi-year retention of logs for audits, we recommend export + archival to customer-owned storage.
- HIPAA / BAA: Redwood will execute a BAA. For certain hosted configurations we require specific controls to be enabled (e.g., customer opt-in for data encryption with our KMS integrations or Private deployment for additional isolation). We can share a standard BAA and note any deployment constraints.

Attachments included: SOC2-TypeII-Report-2026.pdf, vendor-security-questionnaire-Amaya.xlsx

Next steps suggested:
1) Amaya to complete the questionnaire and indicate whether you need an expedited backup purge clause and target purge SLA (e.g., 30 days).
2) If HIPAA/BAA is required, confirm target deployment (hosted vs dedicated/private) and we'll circulate BAA + control requirements.
3) Once questionnaire is returned, we can schedule a 30-minute technical deep-dive with Amaya security to finalize contract language.

If helpful I can provide the standard deletion SLA as redline language for your legal team.

—
